title: Obstacle course
prompt: Build an obstacle course (obby) in this game: a Model named "Obby" in Workspace containing at least 6 anchored platform Parts named Platform1, Platform2, ... Platform6. Starting near the spawn, each platform must be higher than the previous one, with every jump achievable: the top of each platform at most 4 studs above the previous one and the horizontal gap between consecutive platforms at most 10 studs. After the last platform put a Part named "Finish" inside the Obby model. When a player touches Finish, set the player attribute "Finished" to true and print "<player name> finished!". Verify it in a running game.
